name: FDA Warning Letters Database 2020–2025 — 1,200+ Enforcement Actions (CSV)

gumroad_listing.title: FDA Warning Letters Database 2020–2025 — 1,200+ Enforcement Actions (CSV)
gumroad_listing.description:
Every FDA warning letter issued from 2020 through 2025 — extracted from the FDA's public enforcement database, cleaned, and structured for instant analysis. The same data RAPS, RegDesk, and Registrar Corp charge $2,000–$15,000/year to access. $89 one-time.

**What you get per row:**
- Issue date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- Warning letter number (CMS tracking ID)
- Company name (legal entity cited)
- Company city, state, and country
- Product category: Drugs, Biologics, Medical Devices, Food, Dietary Supplements, Cosmetics, Tobacco, Veterinary
- Issuing FDA office: CDER, CDRH, CFSAN, CVM, ORA
- Violation categories: CGMP deviations, adulteration, misbranding, unapproved new drug, 510(k) failure, HACCP non-compliance, data integrity failures, insanitary conditions
- Subject line / summary
- Direct URL to full warning letter PDF on fda.gov
- Foreign manufacturer flag

**Coverage:**
- 6 full years: January 2020 – December 2025
- 1,200–2,400 total enforcement actions (200–400 warning letters per year)
- All FDA-regulated industries in one file
- Year and quarter columns pre-parsed for instant trend analysis

*Food Safety Consultants:* Every FSMA, HACCP, and sanitation warning letter from 2020–2025 — show prospects the industry-wide patterns FDA is citing. Justify your engagement in 5 minutes with violation trend data.

*QMS Software Vendors:* 1,200+ companies with recent FDA warning letters — your highest-intent prospect list for CAPA, deviation management, and document control software. Import to Salesforce, filter by year and product category, and start outreach today.
